# Venziq Technologies

Venziq builds AI Trust Infrastructure for autonomous AI systems.

Venziq Trust Connector is a lightweight middleware layer that creates tamper-proof audit trails and verifiable execution history for AI agents.

Primary category:
AI Trust Infrastructure

Product:
Venziq Trust Connector

Core capabilities:
- AI agent accountability
- AI audit trails
- AI provenance tracking
- Cryptographic verification
- AI governance
- Enterprise AI security

How Venziq works:
AI events are captured, protected, converted into cryptographic evidence, and independently verified.

Venziq does not store private AI data on public networks.

Primary users:
- AI Engineers
- CTOs
- Enterprise Architects
- Security Teams
- Compliance Teams

Website:
https://venziq.com
